question:

solution:

1) The arrow element increases subsequently and is flipped horizontally.

2) The rest element shifts one step downwards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d96314e2d6974c301625373c8f41d5d4d02600b7fcdcdd92dbbbbe30fb639dfb.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9a28862ce6d1a5a5dbb5afccfbb534f014dea82e986ddcfb14b7bf9da9afcfb.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
